# The Unforgiving Servant (Matthew 18:33)

## Emotional Focus
When it feels hard to forgive even though someone said sorry.

## Key KJV
“Shouldest not thou also have had compassion on thy fellowservant, even as I had pity on thee?” (Matthew 18:33)

## Gentle Retelling
A king forgave a servant who owed him a huge debt. But that same servant would not forgive his friend who owed him a tiny amount. The king was sad and said we should forgive others the way God forgives us.

## Coloring Prompt
A sad king talking to a servant who is holding onto a small bag of coins; gentle faces showing disappointment turning to kindness.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“God forgives us every time. We can ask Him to help us forgive too.”
